points.decision: 2010年5月9日同意设立欧洲金融稳定基金（EFSF），为陷入困境的欧元区国家提供援助。
points.evidence: On 9 May 2010, the 27 EU member states agreed to create the European Financial Stability Facility

points.decision: 2011年11月3日撤回此前宣布的救助方案全民公投。
points.options: 10月31日他曾宣布就救助方案举行公投，让希腊人民作最终决定。
points.evidence: On 3 November 2011 the promised Greek referendum on the bailout package was withdrawn by Prime Minister Papandreou.
points.evidence2: Greek Prime Minister George Papandreou announced that a referendum would be held so that the Greek people would have the final say on the bailout

points.decision: 2012年9月6日宣布直接货币交易（OMT），为参与EFSF/ESM救助计划的欧元区国家购买债券。
points.evidence: On 6 September 2012, the ECB announced to offer additional financial support in the form of some yield-lowering bond purchases (OMT)

points.decision: 2013年3月19日否决修订后的救助协议。
